s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic systemic infection with granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Progressively worsening fever, weight loss, night sweats, and dry cough
Painful nonhealing ulcer on the right hallux with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation
Chronic lower back pain with contiguous spondylitis and spinal cord compression
key_facts: Negative sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics
Bilateral reticular-nodular opacities on chest radiograph
Induced sputum trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert
Biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic systemic infection with granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Progressively worsening fever, weight loss, night sweats, and dry cough
Painful nonhealing ulcer on the right hallux with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation
Chronic lower back pain with contiguous spondylitis and spinal cord compression
key_facts: Negative sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics
Bilateral reticular-nodular opacities on chest radiograph
Induced sputum trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert
Biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus

shortlist.label: Tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Induced sputum trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert and biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement, but less likely given the positive MTB test

shortlist.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement, but less likely given the lack of ANCA positivity

shortlist.label: Chronic histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and systemic symptoms, but less likely given the lack of exposure history and negative serologies

shortlist.label: Spinal tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression, consistent with TB

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including a 2-year history of progressively worsening fever, weight loss, night sweats, and a dry cough, along with the presence of necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus on biopsy of the toe ulcer and a trace positive MTB on GeneXpert, strongly support the diagnosis of tuberculosis. The induced sputum subsequently growing MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid further confirms this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: While sarcoidosis can cause granulomatous inflammation, the presence of acid-fast bacilli and positive MTB culture are more indicative of tuberculosis.

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a combination of granulomatous inflammation and vasculitis, and the patient's symptoms and test results do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chronic histoplasmosis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and test results, including the presence of MTB on GeneXpert and culture, do not support a diagnosis of histoplasmosis.

rejected.label: Spinal tuberculosis
rejected.why: While the patient does have spinal involvement, the diagnosis of spinal tuberculosis is encompassed within the broader diagnosis of tuberculosis, which explains the patient's other symptoms and test results.
